title: Positive Weights Do Not Certify TWFE Inference: A Design Diagnostic under Treatment-Effect Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2611.18116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) inference need not be uniformly adequate even when all treatment weights are positive. Under a local treatment-effect drift, the statistic for the equally weighted treated-cell effect has worst-case mean shift $(c/q)\Gamma$, where $\Gamma=\sqrt{N_1}\|w-u\|_2$ is design-only and $q$ is the cluster-score noise scale. Projection matches the exposure to cohort, event-time, additive, and saturated group-time pilots; when residualized treatment is constant within treated group-time cells, $\Gamma_{\mathrm{gt}}=\Gamma$. A direct score estimator is feasible with fixed panel length as clusters grow. Because a debiased quadratic pilot is nonregular at zero, we use two regular one-sided procedures: a reverse-triangle multiplier lower bound to detect unsafe envelopes and covariance-aware noncentral-$\chi^2$ inversion to certify adequacy. translated_title: 正权重不能证明TWFE推断的可靠性：处理效应异质性下的设计诊断

tldr: 该论文提出一个仅由设计决定的诊断量 $\Gamma$，证明即使所有处理权重为正，TWFE推断在处理效应异质性下仍可能失效，并设计了反三角乘子下界和非中心 $\chi^2$ 反演两种正则单侧程序，分别用于检测不安全设计与验证推断可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a design-only diagnostic $\Gamma$ showing that positive treatment weights do not guarantee valid TWFE inference under treatment-effect heterogeneity, and introduces two regular one-sided procedures—a reverse-triangle multiplier lower bound and covariance-aware noncentral-$\chi^2$ inversion—to detect unsafe designs and certify inference adequacy.
